programme.title: Informatik – Bachelor 100% (Universität Heidelberg)
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science Informatik (100% subject share; a 50% variant exists), 6 semesters, winter semester start only; entrance examination procedure (Aufnahmeprüfungsverfahren)
programme.how_found: Official URL found by site search on uni-heidelberg.de (discovery only): Studium -> Alle Studienfächer -> Informatik -> Bachelor 100%; English twin under /en/study/all-subjects/computer-science/; faculty page informatik.uni-heidelberg.de/studium/bachelor.
programme.notes: Core courses only in German ('NOTE THAT THE BACHELOR CORE COURSES ARE ONLY OFFERED IN GERMAN!'). The row has no official_domain in kb_top100_list.json; uni-heidelberg.de is Heidelberg University's official site. The study finder hides deadlines until a programme is 'put together' (dynamic).

value.german_level: DSH-2 minimum (or TestDaF 4 in all parts, telc C1 Hochschule, DSD II, Goethe C2)

english.quote: Generally, the German language test for the admission to universities (DSH) must first be passed at minimum the level DSH-2 and must be proven at the time of enrolment
english.notes: University-wide rule for German-taught programmes; proof due at enrolment (unless a programme requires more). Not an English requirement.

value.description: No GPA threshold: entrance examination; stage-1 pre-selection on a points scheme (upper-school grades in mathematics and computer science plus extra qualifications), at least 23 points = direct admission, otherwise selection interview.

gpa.quote: If the applicant achieves at least 23 points with the criteria of the pre-selection, admission will be declared directly and the invitation to an interview (step 2) will not apply
gpa.notes: Points scheme from the entrance-examination statutes, not a GPA. Interviews end of July in Heidelberg, in person.

deadline.quote: The application deadline is generally July 15 of the year in which you want to start your studies
deadline.notes: Faculty page; portal opens June 1. No separate international round is stated on this page (the central study finder shows deadlines only dynamically). Printed without a year; for winter semester 2027/28 it is 15 July 2027.

value.academic_year: since winter semester 2017/18 (no academic year stated)
value.population: non-EU/non-EEA students with a foreign university entrance qualification (Baden-Württemberg)

tuition.quote: International students from non-EU (European Union) and non-EEA (European Economic Area - Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway) countries with a foreign university entrance qualification will be required to pay a tuition fee of EUR 1500 per semester
tuition.notes: Per semester, plus the semester contribution EUR 189.80 (programme page; 'as of the 2026/27 winter semester' on the financing page). Exemptions under § 5 LHGebG. Not multiplied out.

scholarship_exists.quote: Hans-Peter Wild Talent Scholarships prospective students of all nationalities who want to pursue a degree (BA/MA) in a MINT subject at Heidelberg University, for the first time
scholarship_exists.notes: Listed among Heidelberg's scholarships for studying at the university (also Deutschlandstipendium 'gifted students of all nationalities'). Amount and deadline not read here; competitive.

scholarship_international.quote: Hans-Peter Wild Talent Scholarships prospective students of all nationalities
scholarship_international.notes: Open to prospective students of all nationalities entering a MINT (STEM) BA/MA; Informatik is a MINT subject. The international office warns that scholarships in Germany are few and often require application before admission.
